description: This Perl module defines a Catalyst controller for managing user email change requests within a web application. It includes actions for initiating email change, verifying tokens, canceling requests, and redirecting to account settings.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Settings::ChangeEmail
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class handling email change workflows, including request initiation, verification, cancellation, and redirection within the user settings context.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained action that sets the base for email change routes, capturing no arguments.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Handles POST requests to initiate an email change, validates input, generates tokens, updates user data, and sends verification emails.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to verify the email change token and prepare for final confirmation.

methods.name: post_verify
methods.description: Handles POST requests to finalize the email change after token verification, updating user email and clearing tokens.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Handles POST requests to cancel an ongoing email change request, clearing related tokens and data.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect users back to the account settings page.
